title: "BDA400 Assignment 2 - Technical Analysis using R (Preliminary Stage)"
author: "Bola_Hassan"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 9, fig.height = 6)
source("technical_analysis_functions.R")
install_if_missing()
```

## 1. Portfolio configuration

```{r portfolio}
read_portfolio("portfolio.txt")
```

## 2. Import stock data

```{r load}
stocks <- load_stock_data("portfolio.txt", from = Sys.Date() - 365)
sapply(stocks, nrow)
```

## 3. Basic statistics

```{r stats}
results <- calculate_all_statistics(stocks)
display_statistics_table(results$summary_table)
```

## 4. Data display

```{r display}
for (s in names(stocks)) display_stock_data(stocks[[s]], s, n = 5)
for (s in names(stocks)) display_quote_summary(stocks[[s]], s)
```

## 5. Visualizations

```{r plots, fig.height=7}
for (s in names(stocks)) plot_stock_dashboard(results$stats[[s]]$data, s)
plot_normalized_performance(stocks)
plot_returns_boxplot(stocks)
```
